name: Agent Reliability and Teaching Lab
promise: Teach and test bounded agent behavior with deterministic gates.
completion_criteria: A shared eval covers path confinement, malformed plans, retries, budgets, rollback, and reviewer artifacts.
Teaching examples remain readable and intentionally smaller than production harnesses.
Generic personas and prompt chains become skills, curriculum, or fixtures rather than competing runtimes.
Shared packages have at least two verified consumers before promotion.

waves.objective: Define adversarial reliability fixtures as ExperimentRuns.
waves.acceptance: Confinement, malformed output, retry, budget, rollback, and reviewer cases have deterministic expected outcomes.

waves.objective: Run fixtures across Looping Box, SSSF, and Agentic Harness.
waves.acceptance: Results retain harness version, configuration, raw evidence, scorer, failures, and limitations.

waves.objective: Extract only proven shared behavior and curriculum.
waves.acceptance: Every extraction has two consumers or remains local; duplicate generic runtimes are not expanded.
